name: powerpoint-mcp
description: Create, edit, and export PowerPoint presentations from Claude Desktop. Add slides, charts, tables, images, and notes. Requires desktop Microsoft PowerPoint on Windows.
long_description: Ask Claude Desktop to build a presentation, update an existing deck, format slides, add charts and tables, insert images, and write speaker notes. Export PDFs for sharing or slide images so Claude can review the result. Includes 32 tools (215 operations across 17 domains) for editing presentations through the installed Microsoft PowerPoint desktop application. Requires Windows, Microsoft PowerPoint 2016 or later, Node.js 18 or later, and an interactive desktop.
